output.question: On 2.8, why does my SLA class go down after one missed probe even though the link recovers right away?
output.reference_answer: In Atlas SD-WAN 2.8, the SLA evaluator applies the hold-down timer to the most recent probe result instead of the rolling window when the probe count is below five samples. With 1-second probes and a 3/5 hold-down, a single timeout can clear the class state and start a full recovery timer, so `show app-route sla-class` may report the class as down for 10 to 20 seconds even if packet loss stays below 2% afterward. This is fixed in 2.9, where the evaluator uses the configured rolling window before changing class state.
